opening.argument: The video presents a walkthrough for contacting Facebook Business support about account or page issues. The speaker calls it a tutorial on reaching a live person at the Facebook help desk, then points viewers to a chat option where they can speak with someone live. The visible support form includes contact and account fields, question categories, and a Start Chat button, consistent with the described route through help pages and a support form. Requests to subscribe are ordinary audience engagement; they are not presented as a condition for receiving support or as evidence of financial participation or deception. The observable steps serve the instructional purpose the video states.
